TreeOfLife.description:
The Tree of Life: the ten sephirot (eleven with Da'at) coloured in either
scale and labelled from their magick-data rows, and the twenty-two paths
with their Hebrew letters. Without props it draws as magick.ly's Tree
page does by default. A sphere or a path is a link only where
`sephirahHref` or `pathHref` gives it one, a plain link the browser
follows. It reads the data itself and needs no client code, so it
renders as a Server Component. Its ids come from `useId` when `id` is
not given.

props.name: activePath
props.description: A path's id (`"1_2"`): it is drawn on top and highlighted, the rest faded.

props.name: activeSephirah
props.description:
A sephirah's id: that sphere is drawn and the others faded. `null`
fades them all; not given, none is faded.

props.name: bottomText
props.description:
The field path(s) set on an arc below each sphere's label, as `field`
takes them; `name.en` when not given, and none when empty.

props.name: colorScale
props.description: The scale the spheres are coloured in: `queen` when not given.

props.name: field
props.description:
What each sphere is labelled with: a field path into its magick-data
row (`name.he`, `planet.name.en.en`, `stones.*.name.en`; `index` is
the sphere's number), or several joined by commas, which are drawn
space-separated. `name.roman` when not given or empty.

props.name: flip
props.description: Seen from behind, the body's view; the stylesheet mirrors the figure.

props.name: fontBaseUrl
props.description:
Where Noto Sans and Noto Sans Hebrew are served, as
`NotoSans-Regular.ttf` and `NotoSansHebrew-Regular.ttf` under it. Given
one, the SVG carries `@font-face` rules for them, which an exported SVG
needs; the rules name the families for the whole page, as any
`@font-face` does. Without it the Tree only names the families, and
the page supplies them (or falls back to Arial and sans-serif).

props.name: fontSize
props.description:
The labels' font size. When not given, from `field` if it is given
(32 for `index`, 20 for `name.he`, 12 for `name.roman`, otherwise 10),
and 10 with the default field.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width and the figure's shape when not given.

props.name: id
props.description:
The `<svg>`'s id, which its stylesheet is scoped to and every id
inside it begins with (`<id>-paths`, `<id>-topTextPath0`): letters,
digits, `-` and `_`, starting with a letter. One from `useId` when
not given, so that several Trees can share a page.

props.name: labels
props.description: Each sphere's label, Keter first and Da'at eleventh, in place of `field`'s.

props.name: letterAttr
props.description: Whose letters the paths carry: `hermetic` when not given.

props.name: pathHref
props.description:
Each path's link, given its magick-data row, or `null` for none.
Without it the paths are not links.

props.name: sephirahHref
props.description:
Each sphere's link, given its magick-data row, or `null` for none.
Without it the spheres are not links.

props.name: showDaat
props.description:
Draws Da'at. Only the Queen scale colours it, so the King scale leaves
it out.

props.name: topText
props.description:
The field path(s) set on an arc above each sphere's label, as `field`
takes them; `index` when not given, and none when empty.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; the container's, `"100%"`, when not given.

GradeTree.description:
The Tree of Life as the map of the Golden Dawn's grades: each sphere
labelled with its grade's number and name, with the grade's element,
order and planet below. Like the Tree, it links nothing unless given
`sephirahHref` or `pathHref` (a sphere's row names its grade as
`gdGradeId`). Any of `TreeOfLife`'s props override these.

GdHall.description:
A Golden Dawn temple hall as inline SVG, drawn from a `gdHall` node such
as a preset's (`magick-components/gd/hall/presets`). It renders on the
server as well as in the browser: its layout is computed from the node,
its labels' widths from the metrics of the fonts the package ships, and
its gradient and pattern ids from `useId`, so several halls can share a
page. The node is treated as untrusted: its strings only reach text
nodes, unknown tags draw as dashed placeholders, and nothing is loaded
by URL except the fonts `fontBaseUrl` points at.

props.name: hall
props.description: The compiled `gdHall` node; anything else draws an empty hall.

props.name: art
props.description:
The art for each kind of object; the package's own when not given. A
registry of your own can add kinds or draw them differently.

props.name: className
props.description: The `<svg>`'s class.

props.name: fontBaseUrl
props.description:
Where the hall's WOFF2 subsets are served (such as `/fonts`). When set,
the SVG carries its own `@font-face` rules; otherwise the page must.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width and the hall's shape when not given.

props.name: style
props.description: The `<svg>`'s style.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; from the height and the hall's shape when not given.

Lamen.description:
A Golden Dawn officer's lamen: the collar's ring, the disc and the
officer's glyph, in a −50…50 box. It defines no ids, so any number can
share a page.

props.name: officer
props.description:
The officer, in camel case (`hierophant`, `pastHierophant`,
`chiefAdept`; `LAMEN_OFFICERS` lists them). Any other draws a plain
lamen, and an empty one the Hierophant's.

props.name: discStyle
props.description: Style for the disc, the inner circle.

props.name: grade
props.description:
The grade whose lamen to draw, for an officer who wears another in it:
`portal` for the Portal's Hiereus and Hegemon. Otherwise the Outer
Order's lamen.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width when not given, as it is square.

props.name: ringStyle
props.description: Style for the collar's ring, the outer circle.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; from the height when not given, as it is square.

RoseSigil.description:
The rose-cross sigil of a Hebrew text, drawn through the letters' places
on the rose. It renders the letter centres first, on the server too, then
spreads repeated and aligned letters with the optimiser once in the
browser, and draws the path on. A client component: the server-safe
drawing is `RoseSigilImage`.

props.name: text
props.description:
The text to draw. Final forms are drawn as their base letters, and
anything not one of the 22 letters (spaces, points, Latin) is left out.

props.name: animate
props.description: Draws the connecting path on, once the layout is optimised.

props.name: showRose
props.description: Draws the rose's three rings of letters behind the sigil.

SevenBranchedCandlestick.description:
The Golden Dawn's seven-branched candlestick: a branch for each of the
seven planets, with its symbol, Hebrew name, archangel and letter, set
about a heptagram.

props.name: idPrefix
props.description:
Prefixes the text paths' ids, which are document-wide: two of these
on one page need different prefixes. No hook makes one, so that the
component also renders where React's hooks are not available.

TableOfShewbread.description:
The Golden Dawn's Table of Shewbread: the twelve signs of the zodiac on a
circle, with the permutations of the Tetragrammaton and the tribes of
Israel the signs are given.

props.name: idPrefix
props.description:
Prefixes the text paths' ids, which are document-wide: two of these
on one page need different prefixes. No hook makes one, so that the
component also renders where React's hooks are not available.

FylfotCross.description: The fylfot cross of the signs and elements, as a table of squares.

props.name: cells
props.description:
What each square shows, row by row; the finished cross,
`FYLFOT_CELLS`, by default.

props.name: ink
props.description:
The squares' borders, a CSS colour such as a theme's custom property;
black by default.

props.name: onCellClick
props.description:
Called when a symbol or an empty square is clicked, with what it
showed, where it is and what belongs there. Without it the squares
take no clicks, so the cross renders as a Server Component.

props.name: showColors
props.description: Colours each arm by its element (default true).

Tablet.description:
An Enochian tablet in a version (`version`, the Golden Dawn's by
default): a Watchtower's sigil above its grid on a 210 × 297 page, or
the Tablet of Union's grid on a page of its own (`tabletViewBox`). The
version's reversed letters are mirrored unless `mirrorReversed` is
false, and a Watchtower's second letters drawn small in each square's
corner when `showSecondLetters` is true. A key the data does not have
draws an empty page; a tablet the version does not have, its page
saying so. It is an image named by `tabletName` (an `aria-label`, which
shows no tooltip over the squares as a `<title>` would) unless `label`
names it otherwise or is false, as for a tablet drawn inside a larger
drawing that names itself.

props.name: tablet
props.description:
The tablet, by its key in magick-data: `earth`, `air`, `water`, `fire`
or `union`.

props.name: enochianStyle
props.description: Page font style for the grid letters; omitted renders the Latin transliteration.

props.name: frame
props.description:
Draws a CSS border around the page (default false). Leave it off
where the SVG is exported or turned into an image, which CSS boxes do
not reach.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width and the page's shape when not given.

props.name: highlights
props.description: Squares of a Watchtower's grid to outline, and choose by pointer.

props.name: label
props.description:
The drawing's accessible name: the tablet's own (`tabletName`) when
not given, this one when a string, and none when `false`.

props.name: mirrorReversed
props.description: Mirror the letters the version reverses (default true).

props.name: showSecondLetters
props.description:
Draw each square's second letters small in its corner (default
false). Watchtowers only: no source gives the Tablet of Union a
second letter, so its grid has none to draw.

props.name: version
props.description:
One of the data's `TABLET_VERSIONS`; the Golden Dawn's (`gd`) when
absent or unknown.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; from the height and the page's shape when not given.

Kamea.description:
A planet's kamea in an `<svg>` of its own, square, 240 across unless
`width` or `height` says otherwise, the frame inset a little from the
edge. It is an image named by its planet ("Kamea of Saturn") unless
`label` names it otherwise or is false.

props.name: planet
props.description:
The planet, by magick-data's id; without one, or with a name that is
not one of the seven, an empty frame.

props.name: children
props.description:
Drawn over the numbers, in the figure's units (centred on 0,0,
`KAMEA_SIDE` across; `kameaGeometry` places the cells): room for a
planet's seal or sigils to come.

props.name: className
props.description: The `<svg>`'s class.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: The numbers' font stack.

props.name: height
props.description:
The drawing's height (CSS pixels for a number); the width's when only
that is given, and 240 when neither is.

props.name: ink
props.description: The frame, the rules and the numbers.

props.name: label
props.description:
The drawing's accessible name: the square's own ("Kamea of Saturn")
when not given, this one when a string, and none when `false`.

props.name: paper
props.description: The square's ground.

props.name: style
props.description: The `<svg>`'s style.

props.name: width
props.description:
The drawing's width (CSS pixels for a number); the height's when only
that is given, as it is square, and 240 when neither is.

PlanetarySpirit.description:
A planetary spirit's geomantic sigil, centred in a flex box as tall as its
container allows.

props.name: aria-hidden
props.description: Hides the sigil from assistive technology when the text names it.

props.name: className
props.description: The box's class.

props.name: ink
props.description: The sigil's stroke, a CSS colour; black (`#000`) by default.

props.name: spirit
props.description:
The spirit (its figures' Ruler), by its `PlanetarySpiritId`, in lower
case; none, or an id with no sigil, draws nothing.

props.name: style
props.description: The box's style, over its own `display: flex` and centring.

Chakras.description:
The seven chakras as coloured circles on a figure's silhouette, from the
root at the base of its spine to the crown at the top of its head.

props.name: active
props.description:
A chakra's id in magick-data (`root`, `sacral`, `solar-plexus`,
`heart`, `throat`, `third-eye`, `crown`): that one is drawn and the
others faded. All are drawn when it is absent or names none of them.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width and the figure's shape when not given.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; from the height and the figure's shape when not given.

Moon.description:
The Moon in a phase, lit in gold on its unlit disc with a soft glow,
turned as it looks from either hemisphere: a phase you give, or a
date's. It needs no browser, so it renders on the server; today's phase
is a date the page knows. Its glow's id comes from `useId`, so several
can share a page.

props.name: date
props.description:
The day whose phase to draw, worked out by `lune`. `phase`, when
given, wins.

props.name: height
props.description: The SVG's height; from the width and the drawing's shape when not given.

props.name: hemisphere
props.description:
The hemisphere it is seen from, which turns the Moon as it looks from
there: `north` by default.

props.name: phase
props.description:
The phase to draw, from 0 to 1 as `lune` gives it: 0 and 1 are new,
0.5 full. With neither this nor `date`, only the unlit disc is drawn.

props.name: width
props.description: The SVG's width; from the height and the drawing's shape when not given.

MoonWidget.description:
Today's moon in a tile, with its phase's name: `Moon` drawn as it looks
from the viewer's hemisphere, as from the north unless `latitude` puts
the viewer south of the equator. The phase is worked out in the
browser, so the server's HTML draws the unlit disc.

props.name: background
props.description: The widget's background image, a URL, drawn to cover; none if omitted.

props.name: latitude
props.description:
The viewer's latitude in degrees, south negative: south of the
equator, the moon is drawn turned as it is seen from there.

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, inside the background, as CSS `padding`.

MercuryWidget.description:
Mercury's next or current retrograde, worked out in the browser on today's
date and shown in the reader's own date format, under a picture of the
planet. Rendered on the server, it leaves a blank line where the dates
go.

props.name: background
props.description: The widget's background image, a URL, drawn to cover; none if omitted.

props.name: image
props.description: Mercury's picture, drawn 85 px square and decorative: a URL, or `` props for a responsive one (Next's `getImageProps()` gives them). None if omitted.

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the picture, as CSS `padding`.
